title: Knowledge Doc
content: PLEXUS ARCHITECTURE AND STACK (from the build plan). Four agents (RFP, ActionSwarm, Access, Finance) share one Meko datapack; one guard layer checks every action (injection check, confidence gate, approval, undo). Meko mapping: SOC2 docs/policies = Knowledge; human fix of a red-flagged RFP answer = memory promoted to shared knowledge (learning loop); audit log/undo = decision traces; Catch-Me-Up = conversations and memory; ActionSwarm handing work to IT and Finance = shared memory across agents. Meko does not read Excel, post Slack buttons, parse receipts, or draw the dashboard; that stays in our code. Stack: one TypeScript codebase, Next.js + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Recharts dashboard, Mastra for agents/approvals (needs a check that it connects to Meko's MCP endpoint), Gemini API free tier for runtime LLM and vision (also enters MLH Gemini prize), SQLite for app data (optional YugabyteDB Aeon free cluster), n8n self-hosted in Docker for outbound Slack post and email draft, Slack app in a free workspace in socket mode for approve/reject buttons (~30-45 min setup; dashboard button is the backup), exceljs or SheetJS for spreadsheets, run on a laptop with Vercel as backup and phone hotspot as Wi-Fi backup. Skipped on purpose: meeting audio (use pasted transcripts), real Jira/Gmail/SSO. Meko MCP endpoint: https://mcp.mekodata.ai/mcp. Meko account facts checked Oct 30 2026: Mahi's account has access; datapack plexus-hackcbs-9 created; Meko-hosted AMP databases need the Pro tier so use SQLite/own tables; free-tier limits and datapack-sharing with Bhumika still unconfirmed. Fallback if Meko fails: own Postgres/SQLite tables (lose the Meko pitch claim). Engineering rules: walking skeleton first, one module per prompt, batch ~10 RFP questions per Gemini call with retry/backoff, record-and-replay Demo Mode, commit every 30-45 min, tag safe build 11 PM Sat and freeze at 3 AM Sun.

ENV NAMES: GEMINI_API_KEY, GEMINI_MODEL_FAST, GEMINI_MODEL_SMART, GEMINI_MODEL_FALLBACK, MEKO_MCP_URL, MEKO_AUTH (the mko_tkn_ key), MEKO_DATAPACK_ID, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_APP_TOKEN, SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_URL, DATABASE_PATH, CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.85, DEMO_MODE. SQLITE TABLES: users(id,name,role,manager_id); questionnaires(id,customer,uploaded_at,total); rfp_questions(id,questionnaire_id,number,question,answer,confidence,status filled|flagged|human_fixed,source_ref,human_answer,reused_from_fix); tasks(id,title,assignee,due,source_event,status); access_requests(id,user_id,app,risk,status granted|pending|rejected|revoked,approver_id,requested_at,decided_at); expenses(id,merchant,date,gst,total,category,policy_flag,duplicate_of,card_txn_id); saas_billing(tool,monthly_cost_inr,owner,seats); sso_logins(tool,user_id,last_login); audit_events(id,timestamp,agent,action,status,confidence,sources_json,trace_id,undo_state,payload_json). title: Knowledge Doc
content: PLEXUS CLAIMS TO AVOID AND HONESTY RULES. Do NOT claim: SOC 2 or DPDP compliance (say "designed for DPDP alignment; SOC 2 is the first milestone once enterprise pilots begin"); zero data retention today (ZDR is an agreement arranged with the provider for production; the demo runs on Gemini's free tier whose data terms may allow training on prompts, so drop ZDR from the pitch); "never stored" (our own tables store data; only say the model provider's retention is a separate matter); any productivity percentages or stats we did not measure (cut "40% of the workweek", "15 hours per employee per week", "pays for itself on Day 1", "95%", "under 60 seconds" unless measured); unverified competitor limits (check Copilot, Glean, ServiceNow, Coupa, Loopio, Zluri pages first); a made-up market size. Say plainly what is built live versus simulated (Zombie SaaS and SSO logs seeded; Jira-style tickets on our own board; Slack real if time) before judges ask. Prompt injection is not solved industry-wide; do not call it bulletproof. Prefer quoting our own measured numbers (e.g. "50 questions in X seconds, Y auto-answered, Z flagged; precision of auto-filled answers W%"). Differentiation line: each incumbent covers a slice inside its own suite; Plexus is the neutral, vendor-agnostic layer with one shared memory and one approval and audit layer across departments. Business model: per-seat for small and mid teams, department-level pilots then enterprise contracts for large companies, usage-based for heavy automation; land with the RFP wedge.

title: Knowledge Doc
content: PLEXUS RFP DEBUG AND TEST RESULTS, SAT OCT 31 2026 (afternoon IST). ROOT CAUSE of the earlier "filled 0, flagged 50": the Gemini call returned HTTP 400 "API key not valid". Two causes: Mahi had not saved .env.local after fixing the key, and PowerShell still had GEMINI_API_KEY set to the placeholder "new-key" from an earlier example (shell env vars override .env.local). Fix: `Remove-Item Env:GEMINI_API_KEY` (also clear any GEMINI_MODEL), save .env.local, restart. Retrieval was always fine (21 chunks across Q1-Q10). `scripts/rfp-debug.ts` loads .env.local itself; `scripts/rfp-test.ts` does not, so run it as `npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/rfp-test.ts`. Delete `fixtures\rfp-*` before each real re-run so withReplay does not replay stale files. DEBUG OUTPUT after the key fix: Gemini OK, Zod OK, all 10 rows coverage=full confidence=1.0 status=filled, answers contain specific correct facts. Every row has confidence 1.0, so confidence carries no signal; flagging is driven by the coverage field (full/partial/none). Do not show a confidence number as a deck feature; describe flagging by coverage. FULL TEST (50 questions, model gemini-3.5-flash-lite): run 1 filled 36, flagged 14, correct 42, wrongly_filled 8, wrongly_flagged 0; run 2 filled 36, flagged 14, correct 41, wrongly_filled 9. Q37-Q50 (partial and out-of-scope) were all flagged correctly; no answerable question was flagged. SCORER FALSE NEGATIVES: rows Q1, Q4, Q7, Q8, Q18, Q25, Q30, Q33 were scored wrong, but side-by-side reading shows the agent answers are correct: the word-match scorer fails on wording differences ("MFA" vs "multi-factor authentication", "1 Jan" vs "1 January") and on extra facts in the key that the question did not ask for (dates, sign-offs, counts). Wording varies between runs (Q4 failed in run 2 only). Do not loosen the scorer to hit a number; Bhumika's hand-check of the filled answers gives the real accuracy figure for the deck (28 of 35 under the strict scorer is NOT a number to quote). REAL PROBLEM: Q36 (Partial in the key) was filled with coverage=full ("No, ... DR copies are in Singapore"), because the prompt in agents/rfp.ts buildBatchPrompt had no definitions of full/partial/none. The learning-loop demo depends on Q36 being flagged (human-fix Meridian Q36, Q40, Q43, then Aegis Q3, Q8, Q14 should reuse from memory). FIX GIVEN to Mahi (applied? re-run result not yet reported): (1) replace the opening lines of the prompt with explicit rules: full = chunks answer every part and contain everything a customer needs to rely on it; partial = chunks answer only part, OR the honest answer reveals a gap between what the customer asks and what we do and the chunks contain no policy/option/next step for the gap; none = chunks do not answer; for partial/none still draft an answer if the chunks allow, else null. (2) bug in runRfp: `window.map` returned the promise without await inside try/catch so a failing batch would crash the run; use `async (batch, j) => { try { return await processBatch(...) } catch { return { filled: 0, flagged: batch.length } } }`. CHECK AFTER RE-RUN: Q36 flagged, wrongly_filled 0, none of Q1-Q35 flipped to flagged; run twice if time. If Q36 still fills, fall back to Q37-Q43 for the demo red cells and have Bhumika re-point the three linked Aegis questions. Optional later: prompt truncates each chunk at 500 characters (chunk.content.slice(0, 500)); try about 1000. NEXT: after Q36 passes, backend prompts 3-8 (guard and audit, ActionSwarm, access agent, Cmd+K and Catch-Me-Up, finance) as BACKEND AND API ONLY with a JSON contract per endpoint for Bhumika's screens; the other Claude chat and Mahi have not confirmed that yet.
